integrity: The proof derives a monochromatic-blade dichotomy directly from the half-neighborhood inequalities, then reduces the center condition to the number of center-colored blades. Enumeration is a direct surjection count using Stirling numbers of the second kind.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to generalized windmills K_1 joined to n disjoint copies of K_m with m at least two.
The scalar friendship-graph value m=2 is prior work; novelty is claimed only for the broader structural, spectral, and enumerative statement.
The exhaustive verifier checks small parameters and wider explicit constructions; the arbitrary-parameter theorem is analytic.
Colors are labeled in the enumeration.
title: Majority C-colorings of generalized windmill graphs
